title: Warm Crunchy Mediterranean Chicken Flatbread
description: A garlicky and crunchy light Mediterranean dish featuring naan bread and double fry KFC style chicken, paleo friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together almond flour, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Dip each piece of chicken into the eggs and then coat in the almond flour mixture.
Heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a skillet over medium high heat and fry the chicken until golden brown and cooked through.
Transfer the fried chicken to a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, toast the naan bread in the oven for 5 minutes.
Spread minced garlic on each piece of naan bread.
Assemble the flatbread by placing the chicken on top of the garlic naan bread and squeezing lemon juice over the top.
